an6.118:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ajjhattaṃ kāye (kāyānupassī viharituṃ) …pe…
an6.118:1.14: kammārāmataṃ, bhassārāmataṃ, niddārāmataṃ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ.
an6.118:1.15: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharitunti.
